Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding the department of social and health services providing background checks for home care agencies.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing background checks to home careagencies; and adding a new section to chapter 43.20A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.20A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) At the request of a home care agency licensed under chapter70.127 RCW, the department shall provide information in its possessionstating whether a home care services provider or applicant is thesubject of the following: (a) A civil adjudication proceeding finding of, or upholding anagency finding of, domestic violence, abuse, sexual abuse, neglect,abandonment, exploitation, financial exploitation, or misappropriationof resident funds or property, under any applicable chapter includingbut not limited to chapters 13.34, 18.51, 18.130, 26.44, 26.50, 74.34,and 74.42 RCW, or rules adopted under these or other applicablechapters; (b) A final finding by adult protective services, residentprotection, or supported living program; or (c) A final finding by child protective services. p. 1 SB 6682 (2) The department shall provide the requested information withreasonable promptness, and may charge a reasonable fee for the costs ofthis service. (3) The department may adopt rules to implement this section.
